note: The sealed answer key. Every answer here was authored from the fixture source, where the defect was seeded deliberately. No answer was read from a canvas-scan session, finding, explanation, or comparison — if it had been, the benchmark would be marking canvas-scan against itself. A participant never opens this file, and a facilitator opens it only after a run is submitted.

scene-overdraw.seededIn: pages/scene-overdraw.html — the pointermove handler calls drawScene() on every event, and drawScene() paints the same 400 shapes whatever the pointer did.

resize-churn.seededIn: pages/resize-churn.html — the frame loop assigns canvas.width before every draw, which clears the backing store and reallocates it at the size it already was.

oversized-backing-store.seededIn: pages/oversized-backing-store.html — the backing store is fixed at 4000x3000 while the element is displayed at 320x240, so every fill covers 156 times the pixels it needs to.

gradient-per-shape.seededIn: pages/gradient-per-shape.html — createLinearGradient and three addColorStop calls run inside the per-tile loop, so 300 identical gradients are built per frame.

pixel-readback.seededIn: pages/pixel-readback.html — the pointermove handler calls getImageData(x, y, 1, 1) after drawing, which forces the pending drawing to finish before it can return.

hidden-cache-canvas.seededIn: pages/hidden-cache-canvas.html — the visible canvas issues one drawImage per frame, and its source is a detached cache canvas that repaints all 800 of its shapes first.
canvasAliases: the canvas that is not in the document
